crossRefs.note: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.
I will sing to Yahweh as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.
I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.
Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
translations.bsb: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
translations.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
translations.asv: But I will declare for ever, I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
